audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with the already-audited mirror (aatrox__warwick), and phases[6].side said Warwick while win[6] said Aatrox — a two-layer disagreement on the live page.
audit.why: Mirror finding: Levels 1-2 Warwick; Level 3 through Two+ items all Aatrox. Ratings must be inverse and the two layers must match.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-1 stay Warwick; rows 2,3,4,5,6 all read Aatrox in both phases[N].side and win[N], with whys rewritten to state why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and phase text carried no real cooldown numbers for either kit.
audit.why: Concrete numbers make the sequencing advice actionable.
audit.corrected: The Darkin Blade 14s at rank 1 dropping to 8s at rank 4, World Ender 120s at rank 1, Infinite Duress 1.5s suppression written into spikes[0], phases[3].why and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the entry never names a single Aatrox ability beyond World Ender, and never states that Infernal Chains grounds Warwick's Q dash.
audit.why: Infernal Chains carries the grounding flag; Jaws of the Beast and Infinite Duress are both dashes, so grounding denies Warwick's engage and his escape.
audit.corrected: The Darkin Blade, Infernal Chains, Umbral Dash and Deathbringer Stance named; the Infernal-Chains-grounds-your-Q-dash interaction stated in phases[3].why and phases[2].why; Infinite Duress described as an undashable 1.5s suppression.

audit.why: World Ender at 120s rank 1 is the punishable window and the text already builds around it; now with the number attached.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Aatrox must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His Darkin Blade chain and Umbral Dash healing beat your kit at 3. Keep the wave near your side so he must walk into Primal Howl.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around World Ender's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The Darkin Blade is down to 8s by rank 4 and Infernal Chains grounds your Q dash — trade only in the gap after his third swing, or farm safe.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Aatrox's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses 1.5s and he cannot dash out of it, but World Ender's healing amp wins the fight after it — spend R with jungle help, not alone.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on World Ender's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike, but his first item out-heals it — fight only while World Ender is down.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Aatrox carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, his three-swing rotation plus Umbral Dash healing outlasts you. Carry threat 8/10 — close the game before side lanes decide it.

edits.before: Level 3 favours you since Q healing lets you win the drawn-out trades he needs to stack Q.
edits.after: Level 3 goes to Aatrox: the full Darkin Blade chain plus Umbral Dash healing outlasts your Q bite.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 read even because his full Q combo comes online and both of you can win the trade depending on Q edges landed.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are his: The Darkin Blade drops toward 8s and Infernal Chains grounds your Q dash if you sit in the zone.

edits.before: Level 6 is yours: R Infinite Duress hard-suppresses through his E dashes and beats his escape.
edits.after: Level 6 tilts Aatrox: World Ender's heal amp outlasts a lone 1.5s Infinite Duress if you burn R early.

edits.before: At first item you stay ahead because your bruiser spike keeps you tankier than his first-item timing.
edits.after: At first item Aatrox pulls ahead: his lifesteal spike plus Umbral Dash healing beats your bruiser item.

edits.before: With Q healing and W attack speed you win prolonged trades before Aatrox stacks his Q chain; bait his first Q then walk out and re-engage once it's on cooldown.
edits.after: Jaws of the Beast heals and Blood Hunt speeds you at him, but bait The Darkin Blade — 14s at rank 1 — then step in, and never trade into his third swing edge.

edits.before: Your R Infinite Duress is a hard-lock suppress that ignores Aatrox's E dashes and forces his Passive/W stack to whiff; all-in when Blood Hunt triggers on him below 50%.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses 1.5s and Umbral Dash cannot break it, so it beats his reposition; all-in when Blood Hunt lights him up below 50%, and never into a fresh World Ender.

edits.before: Save E dash to dodge your R and reposition
edits.after: Save Umbral Dash to dodge your R leap and reposition
